story.fullStory:
Billy Idol's "White Wedding" reached #36 on the Billboard Hot 100. "White Wedding" is a song by the English rock singer Billy Idol that was released as the second single from his eponymous debut studio album in 1982.

Although not Idol's highest-charting hit, it is often considered one of his most recognizable songs.

Background
In a 2025 interview, Idol said the song was inspired by his pregnant sister's wedding, often called a "shotgun wedding".

The song peaked at #36 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 13 weeks on the chart.
